verdict.rationale: Solid's docs explicitly claim 'full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration' and list 'streaming SSR' and Suspense among core features (solid-gh-4, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-13), matching the story closely. However, a hands-on community report explicitly advises to 'avoid Suspense ... and SolidStart routing which can be very slow with no workaround' (solid-comm-15), directly contradicting the claim that streaming/Suspense reliably speeds up interactivity in practice. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or docs confirming streaming SSR performs as advertised, and resolution of the reported Suspense/SolidStart slowness.
